description:
Hello, Space Apps! 
We're a team Galactic Poet 

MT Asfi, our team lead, keeps us all pointed at one star. Developer Md. Ramjan Miah turns wild ideas into working code. Cartoonist Atasi Sharma gives anything a face and a reason to care. Editor Susmita Ghosh knows where every cut should land. Operations lead Zihad Rahman makes plans real.

Measure like engineers. Tell it like poets. That's why they call us Galactic Poet.
